item.title: South Carolina women’s basketball rocks Ole Miss, wins fifth straight SEC regular season title
item.description: South Carolina clinched the SEC's regular-season crown for a fifth straight season after a rout of Ole Miss on Sunday afternoon. The post South Carolina women’s basketball rocks Ole Miss, wins fifth straight SEC regular season title appeared first on Saturday Down South.

item.title: Auburn baseball downs No. 15 Louisville, sweeps Amegy Bank College Baseball Series
item.description: Auburn baseball went 3-0 in the Amegy Bank College Baseball Series at Globe Life Field, taking down Louisville on Sunday afternoon. The post Auburn baseball downs No. 15 Louisville, sweeps Amegy Bank College Baseball Series appeared first on Saturday Down South.

item.title: Tennessee drops first nonconference series since 2020, losing 2 of 3 to Kent State
item.description: Tennessee suffered a rare series loss to a conference opponent, falling to Kent State on Sunday to go 1-2 on the weekend. The post Tennessee drops first nonconference series since 2020, losing 2 of 3 to Kent State appeared first on Saturday Down South.

item.title: Georgia pulls off rare feat in 22-0 blowout of Samford

item.title: Josh Elander reveals message to Tennessee team after unacceptable series loss to Kent State
